messages:
ryan.h: Quick follow-up from the RFC — we need to schedule the slab retirement and decide the runtime-slate approach. High level: deprecate old slab router, migrate 20% of traffic to thin-facade, then flip. Thoughts on sequencing?

maya.s: Agree with phased traffic. question: do we want to run both runtime variants in Dedicated for 2 weeks before cutover?

ryan.h: Yes, Dedicated-only for initial canary. Keep Hosted behind a feature flag for at least one week after Dedicated is stable.

devon: Main risk is KV-cache ownership during adapter handoff. If two services try to evict same prefixes we get thrash. We should add a short-lived coordination lock.

jordan.a: +1. Also want alerts for cache-hit-rate drop >10% for 30m. Put the alert in console dashboards.

luis-archbot: Note: previous migration attempt (2025-10-03) failed at 12% due to a race in session migration. See logs: `s3://redwood-logs/migrations/2025-10-03/session-race.log`

ryan.h: Good catch. We'll add a migration fence in the session-mesh that prevents dual-writes during handoff.

maya.s: Ops checklist I propose:
```
- deploy thin-facade to Dedicated canary
- enable `coordination.lock` in KV for 24h
- shift 5% -> 10% -> 20% over 6h steps with 30m stabilization
- run live-traffic diff against golden prompt sets
- monitor latency, error-rate, kv-hit-rate, token-cost
- rollback plan: disable flag and drain thin-facade
```

jordan.a: Also include a small eval job: sample 1k requests from production, run through both slabs, compute QA metrics (BLEU/levenshtein + business heuristics). If delta > threshold (TBD) abort.

devon: Regarding code changes: we'll need an adapter shim in `runtime/router` and a migration mode flag. Minimal patch: 3 files. I can PR tomorrow.

ryan.h: Timebox: target cutover window is 2026-03-22 UTC 02:00-06:00. If we can't finish staged migration by then, postpone.

maya.s: I'll own the rollout doc and the dashboards. Jordan — can you add the QA eval job and thresholds?

jordan.a: On it. Propose initial QA threshold: false-positive rate <= 2% and median latency change <= 10ms. Will iterate.

devon: I'll add the coordination lock implementation and a feature toggle. PR will reference this thread.

ryan.h: Decision summary: phased Dedicated canary, coordination lock for KV, automated eval against golden set, explicit rollback gating. Action owners: maya (rollout docs + dashboards), jordan (eval job + thresholds), devon (coordination lock + PR).

sophia.p: One more thing — update model-profile-registry to mark slab variants and ensure routing policy can fallback to previous slab on 5xx spikes.

ryan.h: Good call. Add fallback rule: if 5xx rate > 0.5% for 15m, route 100% to previous slab and create pager alert.

maya.s: I'll add the fallback and pager to the runbook.

luis-archbot: Scheduled note: `migration-window: 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z` recorded.

ryan.h: Thanks all. If nobody objects by EOD tomorrow we'll lock the plan and open RFC follow-up ticket. :thumbsup:

maya.s: No objections from me.

jordan.a: LGTM.

devon: LGTM.

sophia.p: LGTM.

(ends)
